title: GPIO21/22 conflict: preset buttons 1/2 vs I2C LCD SDA/SCL
description: controller/main/main.c:41-42 BTN_PRESET1/2 = GPIO21/22, same pins as LCD_I2C_SDA/SCL (include/lcd_i2c.h:9-10). Buttons wired unconditionally; conflict masked only because USE_ST7735_DISPLAY hardcoded true (main.c:48). Enabling LCD mode (docs call it default/recommended) collides I2C bus with buttons. Fix: move preset1/2 to free pins or gate button init on display mode; document.
close_reason: Resolved by removing the I2C LCD path entirely (user decision: ST7735 only, controller c0acb10). GPIO21/22 now belong solely to preset buttons 1/2 - no conflict possible. lcd_i2c/i2c_scanner/ui_lcd_i2c_* deleted.

title: Repeater drops RGB: retransmits color 0,0,0
description: repeater/main/radio_comm.c:107-140 parses only bytes 0,1,2 (seconds_high/low, sequence) of the 6-byte frame; radio_retransmit_packet zero-fills payload bytes 3-5 (RGB) before re-TX. Any display behind a repeater receives color 0,0,0 -> digits dark/black. Fix: preserve full 6-byte payload through the relay (store and forward all RADIO_PAYLOAD_SIZE bytes).
close_reason: Fixed in repeater bugfix/forward-full-6byte-frame (b70d731): TimeData extended with color_r/g/b, parses bytes 2-4 + sequence from byte 5, forwards all 6 bytes. Bonus: repeater did not even compile at HEAD (RADIO_CE_PIN/CSN undefined after radio-common dropped defaults) - added local defines GPIO5/4. Build verified with ESP-IDF v6.1-dev.

title: 0xFF null-clear feature documented but not implemented
description: Controller: timer_manager.h declares timer_manager_mark_null_sent() with NO definition (link error if called); null_sent/zero_reached_timestamp written but never read; main.c:335-338 never sends 0xFF, no 3s-delayed clear. Play_clock display_driver.c:217-225 implements the RX side (seconds==255 clears display) but it never triggers. Decide: implement controller-side 0xFF send after zero, or delete dead fields/decl + doc claims (README.md:189/197/309-311, AGENTS.md:309-311).
close_reason: Implemented (controller feature/null-signal-and-cleanup): timer_manager_should_send_null defined, main loop sends 0xFF 3s after zero, phantom decls removed. Play_clock RX path verified present (display_set_time seconds==255 clears). Build verified. Needs lab-stand validation.

title: Repeater: no duplicate suppression, same-channel re-TX self-jams
description: repeater/main/main.c:73-86 retransmits every packet unconditionally; sequence byte unused for dedup. Re-TX on same channel/address as RX -> with 2+ repeaters: relay loops and collisions. Also RX blocked ~4ms during each re-TX (radio_retransmit_packet delays). Fix: skip re-TX when sequence already seen; document single-repeater limitation or design channel/address scheme.
close_reason: Sequence-based duplicate suppression added (repeater 42ecc29). Skips re-TX when sequence matches last forwarded frame. Build verified.

title: Preset3/4 + Start buttons on GPIO34/35/36 lack pull-ups
description: button_driver.c:22-24 enables internal pull-up only for pin<34. GPIO34/35/36 are input-only, no internal pull-ups -> BTN_PRESET3(36), BTN_PRESET4(34), BTN_START(35) float without external resistors. Undocumented in WIRING.md (buttons not listed at all). Fix: document external pull-up requirement or move to pull-up-capable pins.

close_reason: Moot: LCD path deleted (controller c0acb10), USE_ST7735_DISPLAY define removed, ST7735 init unconditional. No Kconfig needed.

title: repeater: uncalibrated NOP busy-wait delay_us for CE pulse

close_reason: delay_us now wraps esp_rom_delay_us (repeater d30cd8e). Build verified.
